entries.name: Agent Constitution Pattern (SOUL.md/USER.md/AGENTS.md)
entries.impact_assessment: Garry Tan 将 agent 人格拆分为三层文件：SOUL.md(声音/价值观)、USER.md(用户模型)、AGENTS.md(执行规则)。此模式直接适用于 HermesAgent 记忆系统的分层架构，可替代当前单一 prompt 堆叠方式，提升记忆可维护性和可迁移性。
entries.action_suggested: 评估将 HermesAgent 记忆系统重构为 SOUL/USER/AGENTS 三层文件结构
entries.notes: 来自 YC CEO 的实战配置，OpenClaw 已实现深夜拒绝响应等原则性行为

entries.name: MCP for Personal Data Read/Write
entries.impact_assessment: Peter Yang 将 MCP server 接入个人健身数据，使 Claude/Codex 可直接读写训练计划。这一模式表明 MCP 正在从工具调用协议演进为个人数据的 agent 可编程接口，对 CrazyAgentsManage 的 agent 编排有直接参考价值。
entries.action_suggested: 跟踪 MCP 生态中 personal data server 的设计模式，评估是否用于 CrazyAgentsManage 的数据层
entries.notes: 信号：agent 工作流向'个人数据可读写'方向推进

entries.name: Energy-Based Reasoning Model (EBM) / Logical Intelligence
entries.impact_assessment: Logical Intelligence 的 EBM 架构强调通过 internal/external verifiers 而非事后验收来保证正确性。此验证层思路对 FlowMind 的承诺/任务治理模式有参考意义：在任务执行链中嵌入验证检查点，而非仅在完成时验收。
entries.action_suggested: 关注 EBM 架构的验证层设计，评估 FlowMind 是否需要在任务执行中增加中间验证节点
entries.notes: 核心理念：certainty comes from internal verifiers and external verifiers

entries.name: AWS OpenAI Agent Service
entries.impact_assessment: OpenAI 结束 Microsoft 独占后，AWS 立即上线 OpenAI agent 服务。agent 基础设施的多云竞争格局正在形成，对 CrazyAgentsManage 的部署策略和模型选择有间接影响。
entries.action_suggested: 监控 AWS OpenAI agent 服务的能力边界和定价，作为未来部署选项评估
entries.notes: OpenAI 解除 Microsoft 独占后的第一个多云动作

entries.name: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval
entries.impact_assessment: 针对多会话持久Agent的内存瓶颈，提出类型化语义记忆+信息论检索方法。直接命中HermesAgent的记忆管理痛点——当前记忆系统依赖简单语义检索，Memanto的类型化记忆（事件/知识/关系/技能分区存储）可提升检索精度和效率。计算开销低于传统混合语义图架构。
entries.action_suggested: 深入阅读论文全文，重点评估类型化记忆分类体系和信息论检索指标，输出HermesAgent记忆系统改造建议文档
entries.notes: 论文核心：typed memory + information-theoretic retrieval 替代 hybrid semantic graph

entries.name: RecursiveMAS: Recursive Multi-Agent Systems
entries.impact_assessment: 将递归推理从单一模型扩展到多Agent系统，Agent协作本身可作为新的scaling维度。对CrazyAgentsManage的编排层有直接影响：当前扁平pipeline可升级为递归树结构，子任务Agent递归调用自身直到问题可解。
entries.action_suggested: 深度阅读论文，评估递归调度机制融入CrazyAgentsManage Agent编排层的可行性
entries.notes: 核心问题：Can agent collaboration itself be scaled through recursion?

entries.name: OxyGent: Modular Observable Evolvable MAS via Oxy Abstraction
entries.impact_assessment: 提出Oxy统一抽象层，将Agent/Tool/LLM/推理流封装为可插拔原子组件。直接对标CrazyAgentsManage的Agent Adapter架构。其内置可观测性管道（非事后日志）和自主演化机制（Agent可替换低效组件）是我们当前缺失的能力。
entries.action_suggested: 阅读OxyGent源码，评估Oxy抽象模式作为CrazyAgentsManage Agent Adapter下一代设计参考的可行性；重点关可观测性实现
entries.notes: 开源框架，可直接参考实现

entries.name: FSFM: Biologically-Inspired Selective Forgetting for Agent Memory
entries.impact_assessment: 受海马体巩固理论和艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线启发的选择性遗忘框架。直接解决HermesAgent记忆只增不减的问题。应与Memanto结合，构建完整的记忆生命周期管理（写入→巩固→检索→遗忘）。
entries.action_suggested: 结合Memanto一起阅读，为HermesAgent设计完整记忆生命周期管理方案
entries.notes: 核心洞察：well-designed forgetting mechanism is as crucial as memory retention

entries.name: S2G-RAG: Structured Sufficiency and Gap Judging for Iterative Retrieval
entries.impact_assessment: 解决RAG多跳问答中的两个关键问题：何时证据足够+下一步该检索什么。对FlowMind的RAG管道有直接价值：增加充分性检查节点和差距分析驱动的检索规划，可大幅提升复杂问题回答质量。
entries.action_suggested: 评估将S2G-RAG的充分性判断模块集成到FlowMind RAG管道中的可行性
entries.notes: 两个核心机制：sufficiency judging + gap-driven retrieval planning

entries.name: Bian Que: Flexible Skill Arrangement for Agent Orchestration
entries.impact_assessment: Kuaishou e-commerce search team Agent O&M framework. Core innovations: (1) Unified O&M paradigm abstracting into 3 canonical patterns (2) Flexible Skill Arrangement - each Skill declares needed data/knowledge, LLM auto-generated or NL iterative refinement (3) Unified self-evolving mechanism - one correction signal drives dual-path repair (case-memory distillation + skill refinement). Production results: alerts -75%, RCA accuracy 80%, MTTR -50%+. Directly relevant to CrazyAgentsManage Agent orchestration layer skill modularization and self-evolution.
entries.action_suggested: Read paper + source code (github.com/benchen4395/BianQue_Assistant), evaluate Flexible Skill Arrangement integration into Agent Adapter
entries.notes: Key insight: orchestration is the deployment bottleneck, not reasoning capability; self-evolution = case-memory distillation + skill refinement dual-channel

entries.name: TDD Governance for Multi-Agent Code Generation
entries.impact_assessment: Upgrades TDD from auxiliary input to enforceable process constraint for multi-agent code generation, addressing instability, non-determinism, and weak discipline. Directly relevant to CrazyAgentsManage Codex-HermesAgent code collaboration: tests should be enforceable process constraints, not optional inputs.
entries.action_suggested: Read paper, evaluate embedding TDD governance into CrazyAgentsManage development workflow
entries.notes: Core concept: tests as enforceable process constraints, not auxiliary inputs

entries.name: AI Council: Preserving Disagreement in Multi-Agent Deliberation
entries.impact_assessment: Addresses artificial consensus in multi-agent deliberation - evaluator agents converge ignoring assigned value perspectives. AI Council three-phase framework + architectural heterogeneity intervention. Relevant to CrazyAgentsManage multi-agent collaboration: maintain perspective diversity, prevent false consensus.
entries.action_suggested: Record design approach, reference for future multi-agent decision modules
entries.notes: Validated across 120 deliberations; architectural heterogeneity more effective than prompt heterogeneity

entries.name: Faithfulness-QA: Context-Faithful RAG Training
entries.impact_assessment: RAG models often rely on parametric memory rather than retrieved context. Proposes counterfactual entity substitution dataset to train models to prefer context. Relevant to FlowMind RAG pipeline faithfulness optimization.
entries.action_suggested: Record methodology, reference for FlowMind RAG faithfulness optimization
entries.notes: Large-scale counterfactual entity substitution dataset, usable as RAG faithfulness benchmark

entries.name: Anthropic $900B Valuation Signal
entries.impact_assessment: Anthropic raising at $850-900B valuation confirms agent infrastructure demand explosion. Claude is core推理backend for HermesAgent. Accelerated funding likely means faster Claude API evolution and expanded auto-mode capabilities. Market window for agent orchestration platforms (CrazyAgentsManage positioning) is opening.
entries.action_suggested: Track post-funding Claude API changes; evaluate auto-mode safety boundary design for FlowMind governance
entries.notes: Market signal, not technical discovery. Confirms strategic timing for agent infrastructure investment.

entries.name: Pu.sh – Minimal Coding Agent Harness (400 LOC Shell)
entries.impact_assessment: A full coding-agent harness implemented in ~400 lines of shell script. Demonstrates that agent orchestration can be radically simplified — the harness pattern (task decomposition, tool invocation, result aggregation) does not require complex frameworks. Relevant to CrazyAgentsManage design philosophy: validates that lightweight, composable agent harnesses are viable alternatives to heavy frameworks. Also shows pi-autoresearch as underlying model, indicating open-source models can drive coding agents.
entries.action_suggested: Review Pu.sh source code for harness design patterns; evaluate if CrazyAgentsManage Agent Adapter can adopt similar minimal-complexity approach for simple tasks
entries.notes: Show HN post. Core insight: agent harness complexity is often self-imposed; 400 LOC shell can cover core orchestration loop.

entries.name: Lookup ≠ Memory: Agentic Memory Category Error
entries.impact_assessment: Challenges fundamental assumption of all current agentic memory systems (vector stores, RAG, scratchpads). Argues lookup is categorically different from memory — retrieval generalizes by similarity, weight-based memory generalizes by abstraction. Directly questions whether Memanto-style typed lookup is sufficient; may need hybrid approach with learned representations.
entries.action_suggested: Deep-read paper; reassess HermesAgent memory architecture in light of lookup-vs-memory distinction; evaluate hybrid memory approaches combining typed lookup with learned abstraction
entries.notes: Paradigm-challenging paper. May require rethinking the entire Memanto + FSFM memory strategy.

entries.name: Risk-Sensitive Abstention-Aware Memory Retrieval
entries.impact_assessment: Retrieved memory is useful only when current failure is genuinely compatible with previous one. Surface similarity in stack traces/errors can lead to unsafe memory reuse. Proposes contextual bandit framework for agent to choose 'not to recall'. Addresses a blind spot in HermesAgent memory — current system always attempts retrieval without quality gating.
entries.action_suggested: Evaluate contextual bandit approach for HermesAgent memory retrieval gating; design abstention-aware retrieval prototype
entries.notes: Complements Memanto and FSFM. Adds the 'when NOT to retrieve' dimension to memory lifecycle.

entries.name: Continual Learning Stability-Plasticity at Memory Level
entries.impact_assessment: Memory-augmented agents don't escape stability-plasticity dilemma — it resurfaces at memory level. Under limited context window, old and new experiences compete during retrieval, causing catastrophic forgetting equivalent. Critical for HermesAgent long-running sessions with growing experience base.
entries.action_suggested: Design memory consolidation mechanism for HermesAgent; combine with FSFM selective forgetting for complete memory lifecycle (write → consolidate → retrieve → forget)
entries.notes: Pairs with FSFM (forgetting) and Memanto (typed storage) for full memory lifecycle management.

entries.name: Safe Bilevel Delegation (SBD): Runtime Delegation Safety
entries.impact_assessment: Formal framework for dynamically adjusting safety-efficiency trade-off at runtime when delegating subtasks to sub-agents. Addresses gap between design-time architecture selection and runtime safety needs. Directly relevant to CrazyAgentsManage Agent orchestration layer delegation security.
entries.action_suggested: Read SBD formal framework; evaluate integration into CrazyAgentsManage orchestration layer for runtime safety-adjusted delegation
entries.notes: Complements RecursiveMAS — adds safety layer to recursive delegation patterns.

entries.name: paragents: Parallel Agent Sessions with Conflict Checks
entries.impact_assessment: Parallel ai-agent sessions in one panel with permission-aware tools and preflight conflict checks. Directly relevant to CrazyAgentsManage multi-agent orchestration — addresses concurrent agent execution conflicts that our current flat pipeline does not handle. The preflight conflict check pattern could be integrated into Agent Adapter for safe parallel task execution.
entries.action_suggested: Review paragents source code; evaluate preflight conflict check mechanism for integration into CrazyAgentsManage parallel agent execution layer
entries.notes: Python-based, 30 stars. Key pattern: permission-aware tools + preflight conflict checks for parallel agents.

entries.name: oh-my-kimichan: Multi-Agent Orchestration Harness (DAG/Ensemble + MCP)
entries.impact_assessment: Production-ready multi-agent orchestration harness for Kimi Code CLI: worktree team runtime, DAG/ensemble planning, MCP skill-hooks, quality gates. Directly maps to CrazyAgentsManage architecture — DAG planning for agent orchestration, MCP skill-hooks as plugin system, quality gates for output verification. The worktree team runtime pattern is especially relevant for our Codex-HermesAgent dual-agent collaboration.
entries.action_suggested: Deep-dive into oh-my-kimichan source code; evaluate DAG/ensemble planning and MCP skill-hooks as reference implementation for CrazyAgentsManage Agent Adapter next iteration
entries.notes: TypeScript-based, 20 stars. Three key patterns: (1) worktree-based team runtime (2) DAG/ensemble planning (3) MCP skill-hooks + quality gates. Production-ready label suggests battle-tested patterns.

entries.name: Ubuntu Infrastructure Sustained Cross-Border Attack
entries.impact_assessment: Ubuntu servers taken offline by sustained cross-border attack, affecting infrastructure for over a day. If our systems depend on Ubuntu-based infrastructure or Canonical services (PPAs, Snap store, Launchpad), this could impact availability. Also a signal that open-source infrastructure is increasingly targeted.
entries.action_suggested: Verify our dependency on Ubuntu infrastructure; confirm backup package sources and mirrors are available
entries.notes: Security/infrastructure alert. Monitor for resolution timeline.

entries.name: MCPHunt: Cross-Boundary Data Propagation in Multi-Server MCP Agents
entries.impact_assessment: First controlled benchmark for MCP multi-server credential propagation. Reveals that faithful tool composition can turn benign permissions into cross-boundary credential leakage — a structural side effect of workflow topology. Directly relevant to CrazyAgentsManage MCP tool chain security boundary design.
entries.action_suggested: Audit current MCP tool chain for cross-boundary information flow using MCPHunt framework; evaluate information flow control policies for CrazyAgentsManage MCP integration
entries.notes: Security-critical finding. MCP ecosystem blind spot — not malicious model behavior but structural side effect of tool composition topology.

entries.name: CARE: Collaborative Agent Reasoning Engineering (Three-Party Methodology)
entries.impact_assessment: Disciplined methodology for engineering LLM agents: three-party workflow (domain expert + AI engineer + verifier), stage-gated phases, reusable artifacts for behavior/grounding/tool-orchestration/verification. Three-party model directly maps to our Codex-HermesAgent collaboration. Stage-gated process can enhance handoff packet mechanism.
entries.action_suggested: Deep-read CARE paper; evaluate stage-gated process and reusable artifact system for integration into CrazyAgentsManage orchestration layer
entries.notes: Three-party model: Subject Matter Expert + AI Engineer + Verifier. Maps to our domain expertise + Codex + HermesAgent acceptance.

entries.name: Persona-Based Agents On Demand: Tailoring Multi-Agent Workflows
entries.impact_assessment: Addresses hard-coded agent architectures with on-demand persona construction for multi-agent workflows. Complements Agent Constitution Pattern (SOUL.md) — enables scenario-specific persona switching for HermesAgent (ops/intel/customer-service modes).
entries.action_suggested: Evaluate on-demand persona construction approach for integration with SOUL.md pattern in HermesAgent memory system
entries.notes: Complementary to Agent Constitution Pattern discovered 2026-04-29. Moves from static persona files to dynamic persona generation.

entries.name: Trace-Level Information Contamination in Multi-Agent Systems
entries.impact_assessment: Uncertainty in structured agent workflows can redirect decomposition/routing decisions, reshape intermediate state, and produce qualitatively different execution paths. Critical for CrazyAgentsManage: information quality between agents directly affects downstream decisions. Need trace-level contamination detection in orchestration layer.
entries.action_suggested: Evaluate trace-level information quality monitoring for CrazyAgentsManage inter-agent communication layer
entries.notes: Not just input quality issue — uncertainty cascades through routing decisions and state transformations.

entries.name: Crab: Semantics-Aware Checkpoint/Restore for Agent Sandboxes
entries.impact_assessment: Bridges gap between app-level recovery (chat history only) and full VM snapshots (complete but slow) for agent sandbox C/R. Agent fault tolerance and rollback is a long-missing capability in CrazyAgentsManage. Semantic-aware C/R provides a middle ground.
entries.action_suggested: Record design approach; reference for future CrazyAgentsManage fault tolerance layer construction
entries.notes: May be too infrastructure-heavy for current stage; keep as reference architecture.

entries.name: CORAL: Adaptive Retrieval Loop for Multilingual RAG
entries.impact_assessment: Proposes adaptive retrieval loop that moves beyond fixed retrieval space for culturally-grounded multilingual queries. Adaptive retrieval pattern is relevant to FlowMind RAG pipeline evolution, especially for multi-language extension.
entries.action_suggested: Record adaptive retrieval loop pattern; reference for FlowMind RAG pipeline multi-language expansion
entries.notes: Core innovation: retrieval-condition alignment via adaptive loop rather than fixed translation/embedding space.
